messages:
maya (product): Proposal: run a small pilot for 'isolation bands' in Dedicated pools. Goal: reduce p99 spikes for premium tenants during short surges. Thoughts?

sam (eng): Sounds good. Need to decide enforcement: soft (scheduler preference) or hard reserve. Soft seems better for utilization.

alex (eng-platform): Agreed on soft. We'll add a per-pool flag + band_percent. Need billing model options too.

jordan (reliability): Add telemetry: latency by tenant+band, band fill, preempt count. Also a cooldown after preemption to avoid thrash.

lina (sales): Customers want opt-in default in contract. For pilot: offer included-with-commit and paid-burst-credit variants.

sam (eng): Implementation notes: mark requests in-band, prefer them in admission, fallback chain before preempt. SDK header x-rw-band: in|overflow.

maya (product): Pilot checklist: config schema, admission RFC, billing semantics, telemetry/dashboard, runbook, 1 external pilot. Success metrics: >25% p99 improvement on peaks, <3 band-caused incidents.

alex (eng-platform): I'll own feature flag + pool schema. Estimate 3 dev days + 2 runbook days.

jordan (reliability): I'll add chaos tests for fallback chain and a stress mix test.

lina (sales): I'll secure two pilots (one included, one credit-based) for 4 weeks.

maya (product): Next: Sam+Alex RFC by Tue, Jordan telemetry/runbook by Tue, Lina confirm pilots. Sync Wed 30m.

ops-bot: Reminder: capacity planning Fri — update headroom if pilot changes targets. :)
